company.name: Skipr
company.shortDescription: Skipr is the autonomous trust fabric for the age of AI.
company.description: Skipr Technologies is an Abu Dhabi-based AI infrastructure startup founded in 2023. The company is building a sovereign and secure communication layer designed specifically for autonomous AI systems and intelligent agents. Its platform enables enterprises, governments, and organizations to securely connect AI systems across clouds, borders, and infrastructures while maintaining full control over data governance and compliance. Skipr uses zero-trust architecture, cryptographic identity verification, policy-based routing, and ephemeral execution environments to eliminate persistent attack surfaces and support secure machine-to-machine coordination. The company operates within the cybersecurity and AI infrastructure sectors and is focused on powering what it describes as the “trusted intelligence layer” of the next-generation internet.
